checkpoints.description: [1/1] a dependency-free static OpenAI-compatible chat client: streaming SSE, escaping-first Markdown, code copy, browser-local chats, settings, and a loopback static server; verified with 19 tests and a headless end-to-end stream against a mock server

impact_assessment.why: The chat UI is split out of ModelDuck so the model server and tuner stay focused, and the same client can target any OpenAI-compatible server
impact_assessment.benefits: A fast, inspectable chat front end with no build, no backend and no telemetry; ModelDuck becomes a server and coding tuner
impact_assessment.risks: contract: a new public app and UI contract; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: chats in localStorage and the API key in sessionStorage
impact_assessment.mitigation: Unit tests for the client, storage, Markdown and static server, plus a real headless stream smoke; escaping-first rendering and a loopback-only path guard

checkpoints.description: chat client, tests and static server in; headless Edge streamed a mock answer end to end; tests pass, gate 4/4; checklists: passed
[1/1] harden the client: parse CRLF SSE events, raise mid-stream error events, keep live conversation objects while sorting the sidebar, block new chats while streaming, and ignore IME Enter

impact_assessment.why: A review found edge cases that would silently drop answers or reorder the chat list incorrectly
impact_assessment.benefits: Interoperability with CRLF SSE servers, visible server errors, correct sidebar order while a reply streams
impact_assessment.risks: contract: client stream parsing and UI behavior; dependency: none; concurrency: one stream at a time; state: conversations stay in place
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first unit tests for CRLF and error events, plus the existing end-to-end stream smoke

checkpoints.description: CRLF parsing, mid-stream errors and live chat ordering in; 21 tests pass, gate 4/4; checklists: passed
[1/3] Add a tested store helper for regenerate, then wire message copy, regenerate, scroll lock and jump-to-latest into the chat UI

impact_assessment.why: The chat works, but users cannot copy a message, retry an answer, or read earlier text while a reply streams because every delta forces the view to the bottom
impact_assessment.benefits: Faster iteration on answers, usable long transcripts during streaming, and familiar chat affordances without new dependencies
impact_assessment.risks: contract: client UI behavior and assistant-message lifecycle; dependency: none; concurrency: one stream at a time; state: regenerating replaces the trailing assistant message in browser-local history
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first unit test for the regenerate helper, existing 22-test suite plus project check, and a headless smoke of the served page

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Added removeTrailingAssistant with a failing-first test; store suite 6/6
[3/3] UI actions and scroll lock in; 23 tests pass, headless Edge smoke passed stream/copy/regenerate, project gate 4/4; checklists: passed

[1/1] Address the review: gate Regenerate on a valid last turn, remove exactly one trailing assistant, update only the streaming message, make actions overlays without layout shift, and cover the predicates with tests; then run Phase 4 and push

impact_assessment.why: The review found an inconsistent Regenerate button, ambiguous multi-removal, per-frame replacement of interactive controls, and a cosmetic layout gap
impact_assessment.benefits: Predictable regenerate behavior, stable Copy/Regenerate controls during streaming, no reserved action row, and tested pure predicates
impact_assessment.risks: contract: chat view behavior and the new public/chat.js module; dependency: none; concurrency: one stream at a time; state: unchanged browser-local history
impact_assessment.mitigation: Unit tests for canRegenerate/isNearBottom and removeTrailingAssistant, the 26-test suite, two headless Edge smokes, and the project gate before commit

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Review fixes in; 26 tests pass, both headless Edge smokes pass, project gate 4/4; checklists: passed
[1/3] Audit chatduck waves: wave0 clean, first10 survey+verify, 11-13 survey+verify, minimal raw-text tail fix

impact_assessment.why: Audit 13 chatduck commits in waves; raw-text SSE tail drops legit bracket text
impact_assessment.benefits: Verifiable wave audit plus failing-first fix that keeps legit [hello]/{hello} while still dropping truncated envelope JSON
impact_assessment.risks: contract: SSE tail parsing in public/openai.js; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no stored state change
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first Node repro, existing 51-test suite plus new tail test, project check 4/4 before commit

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Failing-first tail fix in; 51 pass 1 fail before, 52 pass after; README tree and ADR-005 appended
[3/3] Gates green: npm test 52/52, aikit check 4/4, README 8251 chars with prerequisites/test/tree; checklists: passed

[1/1] per-chat composer drafts: localStorage-backed unsent text per chat id, synchronous save on input, restore on select/create/delete/import/clear-all/init, clear on Send; no wire, render, streaming, thinking or key changes

impact_assessment.why: switching chats or reloading lost unsent composer text
impact_assessment.benefits: drafts survive reloads and chat switches with zero server impact
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new localStorage key and store API; dependency: none; concurrency: single composer, streaming guards block select/create/delete; state: drafts share localStorage quota
impact_assessment.mitigation: restore only at select/create/delete/import/clear-all/init call sites; 20k char cap; corrupt reads as empty; quota failure keeps live composer value; 3 new unit tests plus isolated-browser E2E

checkpoints.description: drafts implemented, tests 55/55, gates 4/4, isolated-browser E2E (per-chat isolation, reload restore, send clears) and screenshot compare clean; checklists: passed
